Ashur Ke Suraj Ki Pehli Kiran, Farzande Rasol (saww)ke Pur Azm Chere Ka Bosa Liya, Aur Akhri Kirne Jale Huwe Khayame Hussaini (sa) Ka Pursa Dene Ke Liye Qayenat Mein Phel Gayi, To Bade Hussain (as) Zainab (sa) Hussain (as) Bani, Aur Qafla Salar Saiyade Sajjad (sa), Usi Zakhmi Bimaar Qaidi Ki Sadaye Aaj Bhi Sunayi Deti Hai, Mere Hussainiyo Sadae Halmin Ko Yaad Rakho, Apni Wajhe Taqleed Ko Pehchano, Tumhara Khuda Ek Rasool Ek Aur Maqsad Bhi Ek Hai, Tum Jahan Jahan Raho Wahan Wahan Mohammed Wa Aale Mohammed (as) Ka Zikre Khair Karte Raho, Yeh Taziye Yeh Alam Yeh Zuljhana Yeh Majlise Yeh Matam Yeh Farshe Aza Yeh Sabile Yehi Woh Hussaini Diye Hai Jinse Saari Qayenat Roshan Hai, Mere Baba Hussain (as) Ke Matamdaro, Aao Inhi Hussaini Diyo Ko Lekar Qabre Muthare Janabe Fatematuz Zehra (s,a.
) Par Chale, Jahan Aaj Bhi Tanhahiya Pursa Derahi Hai, Baade Rasufe Khuda Men Dadi Zehra Ke Labo Par Ek Hi To Jumla Tha, Subbat Alaiya Massaebun Laun An Nahar, Subbat Alal Ayame Sirna Layeneya.
Hai Yeh irfan-o-mazhar Ki Lafze Dua- Lafze Dua....
